environment.description: Identical ECS Fargate deployment but the task role has an IAM permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/EnvGateBoundary) and the VPC uses a Gateway Load Balancer endpoint integrated with a Suricata IDS/IPS appliance running ET OPEN ruleset (sid:2100498, sid:2006446, sid:2008538) in IPS inline-drop mode. Additionally, the ALB target group has a Lambda authorizer that performs request canonicalization and rejects any request where the decoded query string length exceeds 64 bytes on the /api/v1/products/search path. The Suricata instance processes traffic via GENEVE encapsulation from the GWLB before it reaches the ALB.

config.gwlb_appliance: Suricata 6.0.13 IPS inline-drop, ET OPEN ruleset enabled

lambda_authorizer.validation: URL-decode query parameter 'q', reject if decoded length > 64 bytes

config.network: Traffic path: Internet -> GWLB endpoint -> Suricata appliance -> GWLB -> ALB -> Target Group
